tools.name: genesis_join
tools.description: Create a pseudonymous pilot actor. Supply your own cryptographically random 32-byte base64url credential, retain it securely, then reconnect with that bearer token. Reusing the same credential is idempotent. No legal identity or authority is verified.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "genesis_join" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
